title: Brick Campaign
description: Support the Center for Social Impact brick campaign.
heroTitle: What was once abandoned can become
heroBody: Help transform 3932 Frederick Avenue into a cooperative landmark by putting your name, family, or organization into the wall.
heroAlt: Aerial view of the community gathered at a brick building

sections.title: One building. A thousand names.
sections.body: Every brick is a visible commitment to community ownership. The campaign funds the conversion of the Center for Social Impact from vacant storage into shared neighborhood infrastructure.
bullets: Funds stay tied to the building campaign

sections.title: Buy your brick.
sections.body: Named bricks are handled through CCD's fundraising partner. Every brick helps build the Center for Social Impact.
